name: Drake Hotline Bling
look: Two stacked photo panels on the left with empty white space on the right for text. Top: Drake, in a bright orange puffer jacket against a yellow wall, turns his head away and holds up a hand in refusal. Bottom: Drake smiles and points approvingly.
use: The text beside the top panel is the option being turned down and the text beside the bottom panel is the preferred one, usually a lazier, sillier or more specific choice that the joke favors.
slots: the rejected option (right of the top panel)
the preferred option (right of the bottom panel)
examples: Going to bed at a reasonable hour
Watching one more episode at 3 a.m.
Pressing every button until it works
describe: rapper in orange jacket saying no then pointing yes
guy in red puffer coat holds hand up then smiles and points
man rejects the top option and likes the bottom option
dude turns away in disgust then approves with a finger point
yellow background orange coat no and yes reaction
origin: Stills from Drake's 2015 music video for Hotline Bling.
